title: Create benchmark manifest and CLI
summary: 建立 `omega-benchmark` 的 suite manifest、case loader、run config 和 batch CLI 主入口。
requirement: Implement the foundational manifest and command surface for omega-benchmark so suites, cases, and run configs can be selected and executed deterministically.
acceptance: cases can be selected by suite and tag
run config captures model, timeout, and tool budget
CLI can start a benchmark run and emit a run id
